name: First Person Shouter
detailed_description:
First Person Shouter is a cat tamagotchi (virtual pet) rage room with voice-powered minigames and real-time procedural destruction. Take care of your very cute cat, destroy your enemies and escape from eternal damnation.

Come for the shouting. Stay because Whiskers will kill you if you try to leave.

WHISKERS THE CAT

You are in the service of Whiskers, a perfectly normal cat who has given you the power to destroy the world with your voice. There is nothing unusual about Whiskers. This is just what cats do. All he wants you to do is reduce the world to rubble. So cute!!!

VOICE POWERED RAGE MINIGAMES

So your job is simple: go out into the world, shout at it until it goes away, and find gifts for your cat. Whiskers’ things are hidden in the world’s most frustrating environments. There are traffic jams, crowded airports and soul-crushing offices just waiting to be destroyed. Each one of these locations requires a unique approach, just to keep you on your toes.

DESTROY PURR-GATORY

Each time you venture into purr-gatory, the world regenerates and randomizes itself, creating an endless playground of noise and destruction. The game also features procedural real-time destruction, letting you destroy the world differently every run.
